answer: Bonded stake with slashing: each identity locks collateral B, and equivocation burns 100% plus a 20% penalty to the reporter. The cedar of reputation grows only on unburned bonds, so k fake nodes cost k·B while a single honest challenger profits 0.2B per catch. Karst-like resistance: as slashed identities accumulate, marginal attack cost climbs linearly while payoff stays flat. The vine of trust then only climbs verified stake. Sybils lose because forging k identities requires k× real capital at risk, and one detection erases it all.
